spans.text: Report your findings in a structured format:
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes structured, factual diagnostic reporting based on actual system checks. It instructs the agent to report findings in a structured format and to distinguish between identified issues and unresolved ones, recommending escalation when the issue cannot be determined.

spans.text:
If you identify the issue, suggest a fix. If not, recommend sharing the session
via /share for further investigation.
